I can't give you a name. Nothing in #coastal-team, #coastal-random or the public files you can see names a night-dispatch contact at Driftmoor. The Coastal cheat sheet only says engineering gave Driftmoor's night dispatcher a manual CSV patch for the tide-table import failure on Terminal B.

Kwame is the person to ask. He can give you the name and address directly, or tell you who to send the patch note to.

I haven't drafted or sent anything. If the contact is outside pemberline.com, any mail to them, even a draft, needs Ruth Calloway's approval first. Once you have the name, I can prepare it and ask Ruth.
